description: Parse.ly tracker loader on cdn.parsely.com/keys/{site_id}/p.js, whose Site ID rides in the path. Collect on p1.parsely.com is not contracted.

params.name: site_id
params.description: It is the Parse.ly Site ID. Parse.ly documents the loader as `cdn.parsely.com/keys/{Site ID}/p.js`.
params.fix_hint: Replace the path segment with the Site ID from Parse.ly Support, such as `example.com`.
